name: Tinker crit modifiers reach their spells natively (#3116, #2845)
contract: Two passives must keep delivering their crit modifiers through the stock spell-modifier path, with no module binding. #2845 Arclight Adept (705788) is an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER of SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS worth +15, routed to the Mechsuit set by the family-34 override in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, so the crit bonus of Combustion (801388) is multiplied by 1.15: the harness probe feeds 1000 base damage, a ranged-class spell doubles it to 2000, and the +15% applies to the 1000 bonus half only, giving 2150 (2149 when the float product truncates). #3116 Short Fuse (707246) is an ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER of SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 worth +20 that raises effect 0 of Sparked and Ready! (537247) from 0 to 20, turning its otherwise no-op SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE modifier into +20 percentage points for Rocket Launcher (500220). A second Tinker carries 537247 without Short Fuse and must measure 0.

steps.label: Unmodified Combustion crit probe doubles the 1000 base
Arclight Adept applies itself as a passive
Arclight Adept carries its +15 percent modifier
Arclight Adept scales the Combustion crit bonus by 1.15
Short Fuse applies itself as a passive
Short Fuse carries its +20 flat modifier
Short Fuse raises Sparked and Ready! effect 0 to 20
Sparked and Ready! alone leaves effect 0 at 0
Rocket Launcher gains 20 points of crit chance
Without Short Fuse the same modifier contributes nothing
